prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity desktop homepage screenshot 1536x1024 for Dream Clean, a real local cleaning business in Macon and Middle Georgia. Render the website surface itself, edge to edge, no browser chrome, no angled device.
Design direction: The Property Lookbook, a fashion flagship photographic lookbook adapted to practical property cleaning. Near monochrome bone white background, navy ink, restrained medium blue CTA. Monumental elegant high contrast serif headline, sparse precise grotesk labels, matte whitespace, exact editorial grid, no rounded cards or shadows.
Layout top to bottom: compact 90px header with Dream Clean wordmark left and navigation "Property cleaning", "Housekeeping", "Our work", phone "(678) 232-8614" right. Hairline rule. Hero approximately 350px high, enormous serif headline left "A fresh start for every property." Clear readable right supporting text "Apartment and Airbnb cleaning in Macon & Middle Georgia." and "Experienced with property managers and their schedules." Solid rectangular blue button "Request a property quote".
Below, huge photographic diptych takes the width of the left 75% of page: same ordinary apartment oven interior before and after cleaning, left visibly dirty with baked grease and right clean, natural documentary closeup photographs, realistic neutral stainless steel. Small uppercase "BEFORE" and "AFTER" labels above each half, fine caption "A closer look at our work." This is illustrative layout proof, not a claim of actual supplied customer work. Right 25% dedicated housekeeping panel strongly visible in first viewport with serif text "For your home, too." and clear underlined "Explore housekeeping" link and short "Housekeeping for homes in Macon & Middle Georgia." Keep this panel ample and legible; home side cannot be buried.
Bottom sliver begins a section "Property cleaning, with experience." and "No job too big or too small."
This must read as a usable commercial-first business homepage, not a poster. Preserve exact specified copy, no invented claims, insurance, guarantees, star ratings, prices, years, or customer quotes. No decorative abstract shapes. Crisp and exceptionally refined.
approval: Decision page selection luxury-fashion-flagship; user go ahead
